stops.title: Akontaa no
stops.caption: Sɛdeɛ kwan no rekɔ.
stops.speech: Akra dashboard dane kwan no yɛ akontaa: dodoɔ a wɔwɔ gyinaberɛ biara, dodoɔ a wɔasakra, ne sɛdeɛ nkɔdi akyi no yɛ foforɔ.

stops.title: Fa gyinabea so
stops.caption: Mia nsensaneɛ na hunu hwan.
stops.speech: Mfonini no kyekyɛ mu fa gyinabea ne deɛ ɛho hia so. Mia nsensaneɛ biara na hunu nnipa a ɛrekan wɔn pɛpɛɛpɛ.
